svg.title: Quality checks keep missing session identity visible
svg.desc: Quality checks for the event model: deterministic event key, timestamps, accepted event types, and session coverage.
svg.text: Quality checks sit beside the metric
Rows without a session remain visible instead of entering a session funnel silently.

g.text: event_id is deterministic and unique at the source event grain
event_type uses the released view, cart, and purchase values
165 rows have no user_session and stay out of session conversion

svg.text: Source: REES46 Electronics export • quality mart rules
